thread:
Elaine M.: Heads up — batch invoice run (batch_id: 2024-05-18-07) produced 0 compute SKU lines for Satori Labs (cust_id: C-89432). Support flagged the customer is charged subscription + support only. Tagging @Raj P. and @Mike H. :rotating_light:
Support Bot: New support ticket #5821 from Satori Labs — attached PDF shows compute usage omitted.
Billing Bot: Invoice batch completed: batch_id=2024-05-18-07, invoices_generated=1,234, failed=3.
Raj P.: Can you paste an invoice id for one of the affected invoices? I can check the line_items table quickly.
Elaine M.: Invoice id INV-89432 is one. I grabbed the CSV from the UI export — only two rows (subscription, support).
Mike H.: Quick sanity check run on prod (read-only):
```sql
-- count by sku for invoice
select sku, count(*) from line_items where invoice_id = 'INV-89432' group by sku;
```
Mike H.: If compute is missing the query will show zero rows for compute.
Sophia C.: My hunch: recent SKU mapping change for reserved compute got rolled and the usage-exporter started emitting sku=null for that tenant. Could be a mapping table TTL/refresh race.
Raj P.: I see a retry for usage-processor around the same window. Extract from logs: 
```
2024-05-18T07:12:10Z usage-processor ERROR KeyError: 'compute'
2024-05-18T07:12:11Z usage-processor INFO retrying job id=job-8812
```
Mike H.: That KeyError would skip creating line items for that sku. We need to confirm whether the mapping cache dropped and then a codepath swallowed the error.
Elaine M.: How many invoices affected? Support found Satori + 3 others (same org pattern).
Raj P.: I'll grep the job logs for KeyError and batch_id — looks like 3 invoices in that run. I can run a targeted job to rebuild line items from raw usage for those invoice_ids.
Mike H.: Plan: 1) Rebuild line items from raw usage for affected invoice_ids (dry-run first) 2) Compare totals with original invoices 3) Reissue invoices if totals change, or generate adjustment credit if needed. I'll kick off the dry-run in ~30m.
Sophia C.: Also rolling back the mapping TTL change and adding a safe-guard in the exporter to default to sku='unknown' rather than crash. I'll open a PR now.
Elaine M.: Please add finance@redwood.com to the incident thread and include the list of affected customers. I'll pause any automated invoice finalization for batch_id 2024-05-18-07 until we reconcile.
Raj P.: Created a short-running job: `./tools/rebuild-invoice-lines --invoice INV-89432 --dry-run`. Output looks promising — compute lines present in dry-run with expected token counts.
Mike H.: Running the non-dry run now for INV-89432 and the 3 others. ETA ~18 minutes. Will post checksum and CSV when done.
Elaine M.: Thanks. If totals change we'll issue adjustment invoices + notify customers. Filing an internal billing incident (#BILL-2024-189).
Billing Bot: Incident created BILL-2024-189 by Elaine M.
Mike H.: Done — rebuild completed and invoices regenerated for 4 customers. Differences: 3/4 had additional compute line items, net delta +$1,276 across customers.
Elaine M.: Noted. Please hold before sending final PDFs — finance will review adjustment language.
Sophia C.: PR for exporter guardrails opened: #4127. I'll follow up with a migration to ensure mapping cache is warmed before batch runs.
Raj P.: Follow-up: added a monitoring alert for `usage-processor` KeyError spikes and a pager for the mapping cache eviction path.
Elaine M.: Great. Keep us posted on customer comms. I'll draft the adjustment emails once Mike posts the final CSV. :thumbsup:
